title: The Nocturne kit screenshots are in the product: 13 kits, four surfaces each, byte for byte from the design system
detail: public/themes/nocturne/shots holds assets/shots from the Nocturne design system unchanged (site, space, spotlight, email for each of 13 kits). The /themes index and the Nocturne feature page read them in the pages PRs that follow. Mechanical copy, hence [sweep].
